subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: When a paralegal enters into a contingency fee agreement with a client for a tort claim in Small Claims Court, what formal requirement must be met under the Solicitors Act?
options: The agreement must be verbal and witnessed by a third party.
The agreement must be in writing and use the standard form provided by the Law Society.
The agreement must guarantee the client receives at least 80% of the settlement.
The agreement must be approved by a Superior Court judge before work begins.
questions.explain: The Solicitors Act and LSO requirements stipulate that all contingency fee agreements must be in writing, using the prescribed Standard Form Contingency Fee Agreement provided by the Law Society, unless a specific exception applies (e.g., court approval for a client under a disability).
